result.description:
Full-Time Timber Yard Labourers – Permanent Positions (10 Positions)

Location: South Brisbane, QLD
Commencement: August 2026
Employment Type: Full-Time (Permanent)

About the Opportunity

We are seeking 10 reliable and motivated Full-Time Timber Yard Labourers to join a busy timber manufacturing and pallet processing operation based in South Brisbane.

These are permanent full-time positions offering consistent employment within an established production environment. Successful applicants will receive comprehensive training, a full site induction and ongoing support from experienced supervisors.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals seeking long-term employment in the timber manufacturing industry with opportunities to develop skills and progress within the business.

Key Duties

Successful applicants will be responsible for a variety of timber yard and production duties, including:

Repairing damaged timber pallets using hand and power tools.
Assembling new timber pallets to production specifications.
Inspecting pallets and timber products to ensure quality standards are met.
Stacking, sorting, packing and preparing pallets for storage and dispatch.
Loading and unloading timber products and pallets.
Assisting with general timber yard operations.
Supporting production staff with manufacturing activities.
Maintaining a clean, safe and organised workplace.
Following all workplace health and safety procedures.
Performing repetitive manual handling and lifting throughout the shift.
Completing other duties as directed by supervisors.
Essential Selection Criteria

Applicants should demonstrate:

Reliable attendance and a strong work ethic.
Ability to undertake physically demanding manual work.
Ability to repeatedly lift, carry and stack timber products.
Commitment to workplace health and safety.
Ability to work effectively within a team environment.
Good communication skills.
Ability to follow instructions and established work procedures.
Desirable Skills
Previous experience within timber manufacturing, pallet repair, warehousing, manufacturing or general labouring.
Experience using hand and power tools.
Current Forklift Licence (LF).
Experience working within a production or manufacturing environment.
Physical Requirements

Applicants must be capable of:

Standing and walking for extended periods.
Frequent bending, twisting and reaching.
Repetitive lifting and carrying of timber products.
Performing physically demanding manual tasks.
Working around machinery and mobile plant.
Wearing Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times.
3.3.6 Hours of Work, Pay & Conditions
Hours of Work

Successful applicants will generally work:

Monday to Friday
Full-Time – 38 ordinary hours per week
Ordinary hours will generally be worked between 7:30 am and 4:00 pm
30-minute unpaid meal break

Reasonable overtime may be required to meet operational requirements and will be paid in accordance with the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).

Pay & Conditions

Employment conditions are governed by the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).

Successful applicants will receive:

Minimum full-time hourly rate of $26.44 per hour, plus applicable overtime, penalty rates and allowances in accordance with the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).
Annual leave, personal/carer's leave and other leave entitlements in accordance with the National Employment Standards.
Superannuation in accordance with the Superannuation Guarantee legislation.
Weekly payroll with itemised payslips.
Overtime and penalty rates where applicable under the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).
Work Environment

This position is based within a timber processing and pallet manufacturing facility and involves:

Manual handling of timber products and pallets.
Repetitive lifting, carrying and stacking.
Standing and walking for extended periods.
Exposure to timber dust, noise and moving machinery.
Working indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Strict adherence to workplace health and safety procedures.
Wearing mandatory Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful applicants must be able to:

Pass a pre-employment medical assessment.
Pass drug and alcohol screening.
Participate in a site safety induction.
Comply with all workplace health and safety policies and procedures.
Be physically capable of performing the inherent requirements of the position.
Training

Successful applicants will receive:

Full site induction.
On-the-job training.
Ongoing supervision and support.
Workplace health and safety training.
Instruction in the safe use of hand and power tools.
Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Applications are encouraged from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, cultural background or previous experience. Selection will be based on merit, skills, experience and the applicant's ability to perform the inherent requirements of the role.

How to Apply

Applicants should submit a current resume outlining their employment history, relevant experience and qualifications.

Applications will be assessed as they are received, with only shortlisted applicants contacted.

result.description: SKS BUILDERS PTY LTD   About SKS Group Australia   SKS Group Australia is a privately owned Australian company established in 2011. The Group operates as a diversified organisation with core business interests spanning property development, investment holdings, hospitality, and credit finance.  Our vision is to deliver landmark developments in strategic locations, maintaining exceptional standards of quality, innovation, and sustainability. We are committed to creating environmentally responsible developments through ecologically urban design principles.  SKS Group currently has several significant projects under development and construction across Western Australia, including high-profile developments in Cockburn, St Georges Terrace, Crawley, and Burswood. These projects include premium residential, commercial, and hospitality. In addition to our development portfolio, SKS Group owns and operates internationally recognised hospitality brands throughout Western Australia, including DoubleTree by Hilton hotels in Northbridge and Elizabeth Quay, as well as the Holiday Inn Express in Cockburn Central. As the construction division of the Group, SKS Builders plays an integral role in the design, delivery, and construction of our development projects. Since its establishment, SKS Builders has successfully completed numerous multi-million-dollar developments, including the construction of both DoubleTree by Hilton properties in Perth.   Position – Building Associate   The Building Associate provides operational, technical, and project coordination support to the Site Manager and Project Manager in the successful delivery of construction projects. The role assists in coordinating site activities, monitoring project progress, managing project documentation, and ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.  The Building Associate serves as a key point of coordination between project stakeholders, including subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and site personnel, contributing to the efficient and timely completion of projects.      Key Responsibilities    Site Operations Support    Assist the Site Manager and Project Manager in coordinating and monitoring daily construction activities.  Support the delivery of construction works in accordance with project schedules, specifications, and quality standards.  Conduct and assist with site inspections, quality assurance processes, and compliance reviews.  Coordinate and communicate with subcontractors, trades, and suppliers to facilitate efficient site operations.  Maintain site organisation, housekeeping standards, and compliance with workplace health and safety requirements.    On-Site Project Coordination    Support the Site Manager and Project Manager with project planning, scheduling, and reporting activities.  Assist in tracking project milestones, interpreting contract specifications, monitoring construction cost variation, verifying on-site material quantities against budgets, allocating resources to ensure overall project performance.  Prepare and maintain project documentation, including daily site reports, meeting minutes, progress reports, and project records.  Coordinate the timely delivery of materials, equipment, and services to support uninterrupted project delivery.  Assist with procurement processes, supplier engagement, and contract administration activities.    On-Site Health, Safety and Compliance    Promote and maintain a safe working environment on site.  Assist with site inductions, toolbox meetings, and safety inspections.  Monitor compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, regulations, and company policies.  Report hazards, incidents, and non-conformances to management and assist in implementing corrective actions.  Ensure all site activities comply with relevant building codes, permits, approvals, and company procedures.    Quality Assurance    Assist in implementing project quality assurance procedures.  Conduct routine inspections of workmanship and materials on site.  Identify defects and coordinate corrective actions with subcontractors and suppliers.  Maintain accurate records of inspections, defects, rectification works, and quality outcomes.  Support the delivery of projects that meet client expectations and regulatory requirements.    Stakeholder Communication    Liaise with subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, clients, and regulatory authorities as directed.  Support effective communication between office and site teams.  Report site productivity and data to stakeholders, ensuring technical progress is communicated clearly to local management and HQ in Malaysia.  Attend project meetings and provide technical reporting and operational support where required.  Assist in resolving site-related issues promptly and professionally.  Foster positive working relationships with all project stakeholders.    Post-Construction Handover and Defect Management Support    Assist with the coordinating post-construction defect rectifications and handover maintenance across completed buildings during the defects liability period.  Conduct building inspections and identify maintenance requirements, defects, or compliance issues.  Coordinate contractors and service providers to undertake maintenance and remedial works.  Monitor maintenance schedules and ensure works are completed within agreed timeframes and budgets.  Maintain accurate records of inspections, maintenance activities, warranties, asset registers, and compliance documentation.    Building Compliance and Regulatory Support    Interpret and apply building plans, specifications, building codes, Australian Standards, and relevant legislation. result.description:
About Burlington Berries
Burlington Berries is a leading berry production company located in the fertile Northern Midlands of Tasmania. Known for delivering high-quality strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries to major national retailers, Burlington Berries combines innovative growing techniques with sustainable farming practices. Our operations combine leading horticultural practices with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation, and excellence in every stage of berry production. Our team is passionate about excellence in horticulture and dedicated to producing premium fresh produce for Australian consumers.

Position Overview
The full-time Irrigationist Assitant supports the planning, maintenance, and execution of irrigation systems across Burlington Berries’ production areas. Working under the direction of the Irrigationist, this role is hands-on and operationally focused, ensuring that all irrigation tasks are carried out accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner. The role is ideal for someone looking to grow their technical skills in a fast-paced, high-yield berry farming environment.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks
Irrigation Support and Execution
•	Assist in daily irrigation operations including the setup, adjustment, and monitoring of drip lines, valves, and other water delivery infrastructure.
•	Execute irrigation schedules as directed, ensuring water application matches crop requirements across different berry varieties and stages of growth.
•	Observing the crop daily to ensure optimal fertigation programs

System Checks and Maintenance
•	Conduct routine inspections of irrigation systems to identify leaks, clogs, or wear-and-tear on components.
•	Support filter cleaning, emitter flushing, pressure checks, and other maintenance activities to ensure optimal system performance.

Data Logging and Communication
•	Record irrigation and fertigation activities as required, including volumes applied, timing, and any system faults.
•	Recording  water and fertiliser use and report on for each crop type
•	Communicate effectively with supervisors, agronomists, and other team members regarding field conditions, task completion, and issues requiring escalation.
•	Attending daily meetings to help align the irrigation/fertigation plans with the daily climatic changes and crop requirements

Infrastructure Installation and Upgrades
•	Assist with installation and modification of irrigation lines, control valves, filters, and pumps for new planting blocks or seasonal adjustments.
•	Work alongside contractors or in-house teams during major system upgrades or expansions.

Fertigation and Nutrient Delivery
•	Prepare and apply fertigation mixes under guidance, ensuring accurate dosing through injection systems.
•	Monitor fertigation equipment during runs and report any issues or anomalies promptly.

Key Skills and Attributes
•	Willingness to learn and apply technical irrigation and fertigation skills in a commercial horticulture setting.
•	Good attention to detail, especially when working with measurement, timing, and calibration tasks.
•	Reliability and a strong work ethic, including availability for early starts, weekends, and peak seasonal periods.
•	Ability to follow instructions, take initiative, and work safely in outdoor environments.
•	Interest in agriculture, irrigation, or horticulture as a career path.

Qualifications and Experience
•	A basic understanding of irrigation systems, pumps, and fertigation principles is an advantage.
•	Certificate II or III in Agriculture, Irrigation, or Horticulture and one year of work experience (at least 20+hrs per week), or have at least 2 years full time work experience in lieu of formal qualifications
•	Current driver’s licence required; machinery tickets (e.g., forklift, quad bike) are beneficial but not essential.

Salary
.       $72,000-$81,000 + Superannuation depending on experience
